<!-- Chef RAG Android App - React Native Project -->

This is a React Native mobile application for Chef RAG, a recipe suggestion system that uses image analysis for ingredient detection.

## Project Features
- 📷 Camera integration for ingredient capture
- 🍳 Recipe suggestions based on detected ingredients
- ⏰ Built-in cooking timers
- 👤 User profiles and preferences
- 🎤 Voice recognition for hands-free interaction
- 📱 Cross-platform (Android/iOS)

## Technology Stack
- React Native for cross-platform development
- React Navigation for screen navigation
- React Native Camera for image capture
- React Native Voice for speech recognition
- Async Storage for local data persistence
- API integration with Flask backend

## Development Setup
This project is configured for React Native development with proper folder structure for scalable mobile app development.
